name: Bound by Blood
source:
In the quiet, unassuming town of Silverbrook, a lonely student struggles to find his place in the world. When a mysterious new girl, Serana, enters his life, everything changes. A chance meeting sparks a connection—but also sets in motion a series of events that will alter his life forever.

As shadows deepen and secrets unravel, he’ll be forced to confront the truth about himself and the strange forces that surround him. Will he find strength in the darkness, or lose himself to it entirely?

Step into a gripping tale of mystery, transformation, and forbidden bonds. In Silverbrook, nothing is as it seems—and nothing will ever be the same.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/perssontm/about]Patreon[/url]]
